note: 7/7 MPs full_term (tenureDays 293 for all, no replacement-tenure cases, no predecessor research needed). Bill fates pulled from psp.cz historie.sqw for all 26 unique tisky referenced across the group (several bills — 50/89/109/110/121/161 shared by Philipp+Kršková, 87 shared by Kohoutek+Okamura — were fetched once and reused). ARES VR (ares.gov.cz/ekonomicke-subjekty-vr) itself would not render for any of the 13 ICOs queried (WebFetch only received a bare JS-shell page with the single word 'ARES', no register data) — that is recorded honestly per dossier rather than silently treated as a confirmed negative. For Okamura and Ženíšek (the only two with non-empty linkedCompanies) I cross-checked via Hlídač Státu's Vazby aggregation and investigative-journalism pieces (HlídačPes, Aktuálně.cz, kurzy.cz) that themselves cite the same veřejný rejstřík VR source ARES failed to render — those found real, sourced personal ties for several companies; for the remainder no tie could be confirmed OR denied, and that is flagged explicitly as an unverified negative, not fact.

proposals.headline: Předseda Sněmovny Okamura má nejvyšší státní funkci a zároveň reálnou, dobře zdokumentovanou vazbu na cestovní kancelář Miki Travel s veřejnou zakázkou za 6,05 mil. Kč, kde je jednatelem.
